crops.name: Rice
crops.advice: Maintain proper water level, use organic manure, and follow crop rotation.

crops.name: Cotton
crops.advice: Monitor the crop regularly and use recommended pest-control practices when needed.

crops.name: Maize
crops.advice: Keep the field well-drained and monitor leaves for early pest symptoms.

crops.name: Tomato
crops.advice: Use controlled irrigation, support plants properly, and inspect fruits regularly.
